'''Voorsbain''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Factory world/Legends|industrial planet]] situated in [[the Tangles]] area of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. It was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[House Picutorion]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the individual [[Uris]] planned to unleash [[nanogene droid]]s on the population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to turn it into an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Mutant|mutated]], [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].

==Description==
Voorsbain was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial planet]] located in the [[Voorsbain system/Legends|Voorsbain system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Situated in the area of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as [[the Tangles]], it was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Anturus system/Legends|Anturus]] and [[Suliana system/Legends|Suliana systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{RPGseed}}
At some point, the individual [[Uris]] had assembled a team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] that, over the course of several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], developed the technology of [[nanogene droid]]s&mdash;[[Nanotechnology/Legends|microscopic]] [[Droid/Legends|automata]] that could rewrite the [[DNA/Legends|genetic code]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, transforming them into a [[Mutant|mutated]], [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like state. Eventually, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Uris became convinced that he could use an [[Army/Legends|army]] of such [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] to establish his own empire, and he planned to release the first batch of the nanogene droids on the unsuspecting populace of Voorsbain in order to convert it into such a force.<ref name="GH">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]''</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
Voorsbain was under the control of [[House Picutorion]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex. House Picutorion funded advanced technological research on the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voorsbain was introduced in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the game, the planet was mentioned as part of a hypothetical example illustrating the development of unique technology by the gamemaster player. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GH" /> Voorsbain's [[canon]]icity with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity was later confirmed by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
